messages:
pm_jordan: Canary rollout for v3.9.1 in us-west-2 at 10%.
pm_jordan: deploy-bot flagged a +25% increase in reranker errors, asking if we should hold.

deploy-bot: Auto-detect: reranker-error-rate > 20% sustained over 5m. Recommendation: throttle to 0% and notify leads. Auto-rollback is blocked for 'dedicated-cust' releases; manual approval required.

alice_sre: What are the exact symptoms? p95 / error types?

ben_release: p95 up 70ms -> 200ms. Majority 502 / timeouts hitting the ASR->reranker path.
ben_release: Logs show repeated kv-cache misses during warmup, then memory pressure/errors: "kv-cache miss -> OOM on warmup thread".

carla_prod: We should pin Dedicated pools back to 3.9.0 and unwind canary traffic only. Can we do a partial rollback for canary?

alice_sre: Yes — runbook supports partial canary revert. Command in runbook:
```
redwoodctl rollout revert --service=reranker --to-version=3.9.0 --scope=canary --region=us-west-2
```

ben_release: I'll execute the revert and run sanity checks. Also will draft a short comms blurb for customers.

pm_jordan: Do it. @oncall_bot engage. Mark as 'limited impact' but pre-notify any large Dedicated customers.

oncall_bot: oncall_bot: Pager created and #eng-oncall paged for rotation. Escalation window 15m.

carla_prod: Support — please prepare the customer template: one-line summary, what we changed, short ETA. If customers already saw errors, plan statuspage update.

ben_release: Rollback started: "revert started at 2026-03-20T14:10Z", traffic-slice moved to 0% for canary, running sanity.
ben_release: After revert, new p95 back around 75ms, error-rate dropped to baseline.

alice_sre: :thumbsup: Monitoring for side-effects. Filing follow-up ticket to backport kv-cache warmup fix and add a canary-warmup flag to avoid cold-start OOMs.

pm_jordan: I'll update release notes and send the customer notification once Support approves wording. Thanks all — will close thread after GA verification.
